title: AI-Assisted Bootstrap Kit contract (strategic, beyond 50-leaps menu)
description: Profile-specific YAML kits generated by external AI (Claude / Codex) to seed fresh deployments. See ADR-062.

invariants.name: yaml_path_per_profile
must: missing kit file -> WARNING but proceed (no kit = empty bootstrap, current behavior)

invariants.name: schema_versioned
must: loader rejects kits with unknown schema_version
v2 introduction needs ADR-062 amendment + contract bump

invariants.name: provenance_required
invariants.description: All 5 provenance fields required and non-null.

invariants.name: signature_hash_anchored
must: tampering detected by hash recompute on load
mismatch -> ERROR + boot fails OR fallback to empty bootstrap (operator policy)
matches ADR-024 CDC-003 deterministic hash pattern

invariants.name: load_exactly_once
must: second boot skips kit load, logged at INFO

invariants.name: validation_pipeline_mandatory
must: hand-edited kits without validation_results rejected at load

invariants.name: operator_signature_required
must: ai_provider=operator_authored kits still require operator sign-off (different person from author)

invariants.name: no_runtime_ai_dependency
invariants.description: Kit content is static YAML. No AI calls at runtime.
must: BootstrapKitLoader has NO AI provider imports
BootstrapKitGenerator (separate tool) is the only AI-touching component

invariants.name: profile_locked
invariants.description: kit.profile MUST match active Container profile.
must: GADGET profile cannot load COTTAGE kit

invariants.name: l51_schema_gate
invariants.description: Top-level kit keys contract-tested against this ADR.

out_of_scope: Actual kit content for each profile (generated separately by AI on operator request)
Multi-AI consensus generation (future ADR if pursued)

strategic_positioning.competitive_advantage: first multi-agent framework with AI-curated bootstrap kits (not just AI-driven inference)
strategic_positioning.auditable: every kit has provenance + signature + operator sign-off
